proof_roadmap: Isomorphisms modulo powers of the maximal ideal (proof lines 10630-10631).
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that completing a Noetherian local ring does not change its dimension. The proof uses that the completion map induces isomorphisms between the successive quotients by powers of the maximal ideal, which forces the lengths of those quotients to agree on both sides, and then invokes the characterisation of dimension through the growth of those lengths, so that the Hilbert-Samuel functions agree and the dimensions coincide. A second, alternative argument via the dimension formula for base change with fibres of dimension zero is also recorded.
